# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest published version of `runware-mcp`.
Users should upgrade to the newest version available on npm.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ul0gic/runware-mcp/security/advisories/new)
to report suspected vulnerabilities. Do not open a public issue for an
unpatched vulnerability.

Include reproduction steps, affected versions, impact, and any proposed
mitigation when possible. Reports will be acknowledged as soon as practical,
and remediation details will be coordinated privately until a fix is ready.
